opening.argument: The presentation frames a BitClub Bitcoin-mining opportunity around paid pool shares, repurchases, and continued reinvestment in equipment. It is introduced as a “BitClubNetwork” Bitcoin-mining opportunity, while the displayed “Pool Mining Shares” slide identifies a BCN pool share and BCN repurchase. The speaker claims that “That first share will double itself” and directs participants to “Just keep adding more equipment,” with part of earnings returned to buying equipment. The pitch also promises referral earnings of 10% to 18% on repurchases and suggests Bitcoin placed in the club could become 30, 70, or 100 coins. Although it acknowledges “there's always a risk of up and down,” these growth and payment claims promote participation in the opportunity.

citations.quote: Master distributor of #BitClubNetwork Joe Abel presents the #Bitcoin mining opportunity in Tacoma WA August 2015.
